name: What are Low-VOC materials and why are they important for home renovations?

mainEntity.name: What are Low-VOC materials and why are they important for home renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Low-VOC materials are building products with reduced levels of volatile organic compounds, which are chemicals that can off-gas into the air and affect indoor air quality. Using these materials can lead to a healthier indoor environment by minimizing exposure to potential irritants and toxins, especially in newly renovated spaces. When considering these upgrades, a practical tradeoff is that while they might have a slightly higher upfront cost, they contribute to long-term occupant well-being and can be a significant selling point for properties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Low-VOC materials have fewer chemicals that off-gas, improving indoor air quality and creating a healthier home. They are important for minimizing exposure to potential irritants and toxins.
